baseline_difference: chunk_page_boundaries=false only; both use the same final prompt, evaluation fixes and serving limits
development_repairs: Added concise-answer guidance after broad introductions exceeded 350 output tokens.
Expanded the bilingual refusal phrase proxy; it remains a heuristic, not human-judged accuracy.
decision: Keep page boundaries: exact-page browser and lifecycle tests pass, dev recall unchanged and context more precise. MRR decreases; report this tradeoff.
held_out_policy: Run both frozen configurations once on the same 70 questions. Report every error and negative outcome; no tuning from held-out answers. QASPER remains a separate external paragraph benchmark.
